name: panes
title: Panes
author: Bennett Garcia
summary: Split, rename, close and rearrange panes, or choose what they show.
description: Adds pane layout commands and menus, including splitting with a new shell and showing another resource. Closing a pane stops its program, asking first while one is running; you can keep it running instead. Turn this off to lose these pane commands and shortcuts, not the programs or the built-in recovery controls.

works_with.without: Split cannot start a shell; closing the only pane leaves the layout unchanged
An agent is shown as its bridge terminal
Closing an agent pane can't stop the agent; the pane stays open and says why

keys: Prefix b: pane to a new tab
Prefix M: pane to another tab
